summary: Add HeyAsa ops v1 model and communication cost ledger emitter (KPI-04)

delivery.outcome: Deliver a deterministic heyasa.ops.v1 cost and model-invocation ledger emitter (KPI-04) in subactor/subllm supporting charge_id idempotency, retry and fallback attribution, unknown-fee completeness guards, locked PLN pricing metadata, and separation of provider statuses from business goal verification.
nonGoals: Do not modify existing SubLLM client_types.py or usage.py paths reserved by ticket-199.
Do not emit case.goal_verified from provider or webhook callbacks.

architecture.decision: Implement KpiCostLedger and DeploymentContext in a standalone stdlib module src/subllm/kpi_ledger.py conforming strictly to heyasa.ops.v1 payload schemas, re-export from src/subllm/__init__.py, and verify with unit tests in tests/test_kpi_ledger.py.
interfaceChanges: Export KpiCostLedger, DeploymentContext, CostAuditRecord, KpiLedgerError, and IncompleteCostMeasurementError from subllm
architecture.rollback: Revert src/subllm/kpi_ledger.py, tests/test_kpi_ledger.py, and re-exports via protected PR delivery.
